notes.title: Demo Uploaded & Discord Server
notes.content:
Hello friends and comrades of Ogalia!

The developer is glad to announce that the demo is now playable, and a Discord server has been set up for all Ogalian citizens to join!

✨[url=https://discord.gg/zS6uG4Cnp4]Click on this link to join our Discord[/url]✨

Also, for those of you who joined us at MAGFest 2025 at National Harbor, thank you for playing our game! Silencer achieved a 55% wishlist conversion rate at MAGFest, and without your support, this wouldn't be possible!

(And yeah, next time, we are still going to bring tea to a con. Good Ogalian citizens drink tea.)

Edit on Feb 3, 2025:
So the dev apparently forgot to say long live Ogalia.
Well, long live Ogalia then. Now stop bothering me, Barbara.

notes.title: Silencer at PlayNYC
notes.content:
[h1]Silencer at PlayNYC![/h1]

We are showing at PlayNYC at the NYU Game Center Incubator booth on
[list]
[*]Saturday (8/23) from 1 pm to 4 pm and
[*]Sunday (8/24) from 10 am to 12:30 pm.
[/list]
Come by, and let's play some games!

[h3]And hush hush...[/h3]
We have tea ready for you.
That's right! As a good employee and upright citizen of Ogalia, you are all entitled to some good tea (bags) and some cool stickers.

See you soon, and long live Ogalia!
